theorems.name: Submission.dsmc_chart_tangentSpace_eq_range
theorems.statement: ∀ (P r d : ℕ) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (V : Set (Euclid d)) (W : Set (Euclid P)) (ψ : Euclid d → Euclid P), 1 ≤ r → IsOpen V → IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ r ψ V → InjOn ψ V → ψ '' V = W ∩ N → (∀ K ⊆ W, IsCompact K → IsCompact (V ∩ ψ ⁻¹' K)) → (∀ z ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ z)) → ∀ v ∈ V, tangentSpace N (ψ v) = Set.range (fderiv ℝ ψ v) ∧ (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ v' ∈ V, dist (ψ v') (ψ v) < δ → dist v' v < ε) ∧ (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ y ∈ N, dist y (ψ v) < δ → ∃ a : Euclid d, ‖y - ψ v - fderiv ℝ ψ v a‖ ≤ ε * ‖y - ψ v‖)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
